title: The Lawyer Gap for Seniors: Residents 65+ per Employed Lawyer by State and Metro/Nonmetro Area
description:
Seniors (65+) per employed lawyer for 50 states + DC and 521 BLS metro and nonmetro areas, from BLS OEWS May 2025, Census Vintage 2025 population estimates and County Business Patterns 2023.

Live page: https://familyestateguide.com/estate-planning-data/probate-lawyer-gap-seniors-per-lawyer/. Published by Family Estate Guide.

Rights review: None in the data. American Bar Association lawyer-population counts were considered as a cross-check but not used (not downloaded; not openly licensed).

Not legal, tax, financial or medical advice. Figures are estimates with sampling error; legal rules change. Verify anything important with the original source or a qualified professional.
